scope: user basic simulation to real pickup test
notes: USER BASIC SIM-TO-REAL TEST SUCCESS on arm001, reassigned from occupied arm002. PLA mug lip grip: real wall contact, controlled lift, about 31.9 mm diagnostic TOOL rise (not measured mug clearance), stable five-second paired-camera hold with 26 fresh frame pairs and unchanged encoders. Then lowered, opened jaws, and withdrew; mug remained on table. No faults, force/calibration unchanged. Evidence tools/supervisor_hold_1790275654263499662 and tools/supervisor_lip_*. This is pickup-only success for the latest user test; held-home, workspace coverage, 2:1 ratio and six/hour NOT demonstrated.
